solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Small bird box dispute

parts.note: to spar is to box, as boxers do in practice
a row is a quarrel or dispute

explanation.surface: A tiny bird gets into a fight over its nesting box.
explanation.definitionFit: The sparrow is a familiar little brown songbird, so it is an example of a small bird.

clue.text: Removal of older person's allowance after suspicion

indicators.note: after tells us the allowance comes behind the suspicion piece in the answer

parts.note: sus is British slang for suspicion, as in being picked up 'on sus'
a pension is the regular payment made to a retired person

explanation.surface: A pensioner's benefit is stopped because someone suspects fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Removal' is the definition in the sense of being temporarily taken off duty, not taking something away.
explanation.definitionFit: A suspension is a temporary removal, for instance of a player or official from duty.

clue.text: Area yielded plant of the aloe family

parts.note: to yield is to give, so yielded means gave

explanation.surface: A patch of ground produced a succulent related to aloes.
explanation.definitionFit: The agave is a spiky succulent, the source of tequila, grouped with aloes in older botany.

clue.text: Frightful racket car produces here?

indicators.note: frightful signals that the letters of the two following words are thrown into a dreadful mess

explanation.surface: A deafening noise made by a speeding car, and where it happens.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: 'Frightful' scrambles RACKET CAR, and the clue as a whole describes the place where cars make such a din.
explanation.definitionFit: A circuit where cars race is exactly where a dreadful engine noise is made.

clue.text: Unfortunate person to throw up after whiskey

indicators.note: after puts the vomiting word behind the whiskey letter in the answer

parts.note: whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to retch is to heave as if to vomit

explanation.surface: Someone sick after drinking too much whiskey.
explanation.definitionFit: A wretch is a pitiable, miserable or unlucky individual.

clue.text: Backed local voting area appeal

indicators.note: backed tells us the word for the voting district is read from back to front

parts.note: a ward is a local electoral district

explanation.surface: A local council area made a plea that it supported.
explanation.definitionFit: A draw is an attraction or pull, the thing that appeals to people.

clue.text: Party time hit

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: A party where the hour turned out to be a success.
explanation.definitionFit: To dot someone is informal British for striking or punching them.

clue.text: Shorten a game

parts.note: bridge is the card game

explanation.surface: Cut a sporting match short.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to condense or cut it down.

clue.text: Ocean of southeast Asia, primarily

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for southeast

indicators.note: primarily means we take just the opening letter of the word for the continent

explanation.surface: Naming a body of water in the south-eastern part of Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea and ocean are used loosely as synonyms for a great body of salt water.

clue.text: Cute rare flying animal

indicators.note: flying suggests the letters of the two words are sent in all directions and come down rearranged

explanation.surface: A sweet, uncommon beast takes to the air.
explanation.definitionFit: Creature is a general word for any living beast.

clue.text: Lonely end to the working week, going on for ever

parts.note: Friday, abbreviated Fri, is the last day of the usual working week
something endless goes on for ever

explanation.surface: A solitary worker finds the week's end seems to last for ever.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no friends is a cause or form of loneliness, so the two are near synonyms.

clue.text: Employ specialist to remove piano

indicators.note: to remove signals that the music letter is taken out of the specialist

parts.note: an expert is a specialist
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: Hiring an expert to take away a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: To exert strength or influence is to put it to use, so it means to employ.

clue.text: Rich soup — food to get embarrassed about

parts.note: chow is slang for food

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the colour word is read backwards

parts.note: an embarrassed person goes red

explanation.surface: A diner blushing over a bowl of thick soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Chowder is a thick, creamy soup, typically made with clams or fish.

clue.text: Where chess players meet, heading for drink?

definitions.meaning: chess opponents face each other over the board
someone falling ... is going into 'the drink', slang for the sea

explanation.surface: Chess players meet in a bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The drink' is slang for the sea, so going overboard is heading for it, not for a bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Players sit over the board, and anything going over a ship's side lands in the sea.

clue.text: Cola is served up in informal gathering

indicators.note: served up suggests the letters are dished out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Soft drinks are handed round at a casual get-together.
explanation.definitionFit: A social is a friendly party or get-together organised by a club or group.

clue.text: Company with unfortunate legal picture

indicators.note: unfortunate suggests the word legal has met with mishap and comes out jumbled

explanation.surface: A firm's legal trouble makes for a sorry picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A collage is a work of art made by pasting together scraps of paper and images.

clue.text: Calm observed around queen, note

indicators.note: around means the word for observed is placed round the royal letter

parts.note: something observed has been seen
R is short for regina, Latin for queen
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone stayed composed when seen with the queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Serene describes a peaceful, tranquil and untroubled state.

clue.text: Make wealthy leaders of English nobility remain in city homes

indicators.note: leaders of tells us to take the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: English aristocrats grow richer by keeping town houses.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrich someone is to make them rich.

clue.text: What keeps out water from paintings by family members

parts.note: oils are paintings done in oil paint
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: Pictures by relatives that somehow repel rain.
explanation.definitionFit: An oilskin is a waterproof coat made of oil-treated cloth, worn by sailors.

clue.text: British state is rather dull and uninteresting

parts.note: a land is a country or state

explanation.surface: A complaint that the UK is rather boring.
explanation.definitionFit: Bland food or company is flat, lacking flavour or excitement.

clue.text: Friend with a note to pass

parts.note: mi (or me) is the third note of the sol-fa scale
to go is to pass, as time goes by

explanation.surface: A pal passes over a note.
explanation.definitionFit: Amigo is the Spanish word for friend, used in English too.

clue.text: Saint in charge with a large church

parts.note: St Basil the Great was an early church father

explanation.surface: A holy man running a great church.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is an important church given special status, often large and grand.

clue.text: Unwell young mare loses coat

indicators.note: loses coat means the horse word sheds its outer layer, its first and last letters

parts.note: a filly is a young female horse

explanation.surface: A sick young horse is moulting.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill and unwell both mean sick.

clue.text: Coldness at the heart of policemen

indicators.note: at the heart of tells us to take the central letters of the word for officers

explanation.surface: An icy manner lies deep within the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Ice stands for coldness, literally or of manner, as in 'there was ice in her voice'.

clue.text: Live without daughter and without difficulty

indicators.note: without means the family letter is dropped from the word for live

parts.note: to dwell is to live somewhere

explanation.surface: Getting by easily after the daughter has left home.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something well can mean doing it easily, as in 'you may well find it'.

clue.text: Draw a veil over old America, very unpleasant

parts.note: to draw a veil over something is to hide it
US stands for the United States of America

explanation.surface: Covering up the ugly side of America's past.
explanation.definitionFit: Hideous means extremely ugly or repellent, so very unpleasant.
